record.What's New Item: Enhanced Accessibility for Table Editing and Row Actions - Workday 2025 Release 2
record.Feature Description:
Workday introduces a more intuitive way to edit tables with Add Row, Remove Row and Select Row functionality compatible with assistive technology. 
This feature improves accessibility for all users, enabling those who rely on assistive technology, such as screen readers and keyboard-only navigation, to interact with edit tables more effectively. This creates a more inclusive and usable experience, ensuring all users can manage data efficiently.
record.New Functionality Title: Enhanced Accessibility for Table Editing and Row Actions
record.New Functionality:
We're enhancing the accessibility of edit tables across Workday. These changes apply to tables where you can add, remove, or select rows. 
     • Tables are now fully navigable using only a keyboard, so you can seamlessly add and remove rows. 
    • Accessible tooltips display on mouse hover and keyboard focus for the Add Row and Remove Row buttons, and for the Select Row and Select All checkboxes. 
 For screen reader users, we now announce: 
     • Column and row header names. 
    • Column sort order (ascending or descending) and instructions for sorting. 
    • Required fields. 
    • Add Row and Remove Row button actions. 
    • Select Row and Select All checkboxes (not selected, partially selected, or selected).
record.Training & Testing Impact: This feature may require additional testing and may impact your training materials.

record.What's New Item: Percent Favorable Score Mode - Workday 2025 Release 1
record.Feature Description:
We introduce a new score view mode to help customers transition from legacy rating scales and better align with familiar metrics. 
This release is part of our ongoing work to make Peakon more flexible and intuitive for organizations used to different survey formats. 
 It bridges a key gap between legacy survey tools and Peakon’s analytics approach, helping leaders interpret results faster and more confidently.
record.New Functionality:
You can now set percent favorable as the default score view in Peakon. 
 This new score mode shows the percentage of responses and breaks down all responses into 3 clear categories: 
     • 0-3: Unfavorable 
    • 4-6: Neutral 
    • 7-10: Favorable 
 Administrators can apply 2 new different modes across all manager dashboards directly from the Data Settings panel: 
     • Average score with favorability distribution 
    • Favorability percentage with favorability distribution 
 Managers will then see the favorable score and its full distribution by default, making results easier to interpret.

record.What's New Item: Certificate of Eligibles - Workday 2025 Release 1 - Certificate of Eligibles
record.Feature Description:
With this release, Workday enables you to generate a list of eligible candidates for job requisitions. Selecting officials, such as recruiters and hiring managers, can now qualify, track, and hire the best eligible candidates by creating a certificate. 
Certificate of Eligibles enables hiring managers and recruiters to efficiently assess candidates who meet federal, state, or local government compliance. This feature can be used in tandem with Candidate Rating, Candidate Ranking, and Veteran's Preference which are all configurable.
record.New Functionality:
New Domains 
 We deliver the following domains (secured to the Recruiting functional area): 
 Manage: Certificate of Eligibles 
 
 Audit: Certificate of Eligibles 
 
 New Security Segments 
 We add these 2 new security segments to the Workday delivered Job Application Security Segment to ensure hiring managers can only view and take action on applications from the candidate grid that have been part of issued certificates: 
 Active Certificate of Eligibles 
 
 All Certificate of Eligibles 
 
 New Business Processes and Tasks 
 Workday delivers the following business processes (secured to the Recruiting functional area): 
 Create Certificate of Eligibles, which enables selecting officials to determine criteria for a candidate to be placed on a certificate. 
 
 Return Certificate of Eligibles, which enables selecting officials to return the certificate. 
 
 You can use the new Create Certificate of Eligibles task to initiate an action on the Create Certificate of Eligibles business process and as a subprocess on the Return Certificate of Eligibles business process. The Return Certificate of Eligibles business process and the Return Certificate of Eligibles task (accessed from the certificate) allows you to request additional candidates. In addition, you can choose to save the task for later and revisit your candidate list by using the new Revise Certificate of Eligibles task (accessed from My Tasks or the Revise Certificate of Eligibles button on the Candidates tab). 
 Workday also delivers a new Audit Certificate of Eligibles task (secured to the Audit: Certificate of Eligibles domain) so that you can audit a returned or expired Certificate of Eligibles with the related actions menu from a Certificate of Eligibles instance. 
 New Report 
 We deliver a new View Certificate of Eligibles report (secured to the Manage: Certificate of Eligibles domain) so that you can view a list of candidates by job requisition and profile. 
 Certificate of Eligibles Sequence Generator Function 
 We deliver a new certificate of eligibles sequence generator function on the Edit Tenant Setup – HCM task enabling you to set up a sequence generator for the ID Definition for Certificate of Eligibles report field. 
 Certificate of Eligibles Grid 
 We add a new Certificate of Eligibles grid that you can customize and configure on the Maintain Candidate List Assignment task. 
 
 Web Services 
 We also update these new web services so that you can update the certificate of eligibles grid field: 
 Get Maintain Candidate List Assignments 
 
 Put Maintain Candidate List Assignment 
 
 Note: To use this functionality, you must update the web service to v44.1 or later.

record.What's New Item: Data Deletion Self Service - Workday 2025 Release 1 - Data Deletion Self Service
record.Feature Description:
With this release, we empower administrators to delete employee scores and comments, as well as sensitive and restricted attribute data. 
 
Administrators no longer need to get support from Workday to delete data.

The Trickle Index Query Status field displays the status of the scrambled value reindexing operation, enabling you to avoid inaccurate search results in the tenant that can result prior to when reindexing completes.
record.New Functionality Title: Data Scramble Trickle Index Query Status

record.What's New Item: Dataset Publishing for Prism Analytics - Workday 2025 Release 1 - Dataset Publishing for Prism Analytics
record.Feature Description:
With this release, Workday improves the dataset publishing infrastructure. 
This feature improves the calculation of reportable rows in a published dataset.
record.New Functionality:
When you publish a dataset, Workday treats each physical row as a reportable row rather than counting reportable rows based on the number of characters in a row. 
 For data integrity and system stability, we added a validation to ensure the field display name of a dataset is less than 255 characters. You can't publish a dataset if the field display name exceeds 255 characters.

record.What's New Item: Expense Report Notifications in Workday Everywhere - Workday 2024 Release 1 - Expense Report Notifications in Workday Everywhere
record.Feature: Expense Report Notifications in Workday Everywhere
record.Feature Description:
Workday Everywhere now notifies workers when their expense reports have been reviewed. Managers now receive notifications when their workers submit new expense reports. 
This feature increases: 
     • Task completion for workers by providing a direct link to the expense report. 
    • Workers' visibility into their expenses by surfacing updates to their expense reports directly to their Slack and Microsoft Teams workspaces.
record.New Functionality Title: Expense Report Notifications in Workday Everywhere
record.New Functionality:
Workday Everywhere now delivers Slack or Microsoft Teams notifications to: 
     • Managers when their workers submit new expense reports. 
    • Workers when their expense reports have been reviewed. 
 Notifications include: 
     • A link to view the expense report in Workday. 
    • Comments from the reviewer, if applicable. 
    • The expense report number, memo, and other details. 
    • Whether the expense is approved, denied, or sent back for revision. 
 You can disable expense notifications, which Workday enables by default, by accessing the Set Up Notifications for Workday Everywhere task and clearing the new Active check box for Expenses on the Workday Everywhere Notifications tab. 
 When you receive an expense approval notification, you have the option of muting further expense approval notifications by clicking Mute these notifications in the notification. Workday Everywhere then notifies you of the mute status, which you can unmute at any time by clicking Unmute these notifications. When muted, you can track expenses pending your approval from Workday Tasks on the Home tab. 
 
 When you receive 6 or more expense approval notifications in an hour, Workday automatically mutes the notifications and sends you a notification. Again, you can unmute the notifications by clicking Unmute these notifications in the notification.

record.What's New Item: Merging Security Policies - Workday 2025 Release 1 - Merging Security Policies
record.Feature Description:
Workday now enables you to migrate modified security policies with significantly improved safety and granular control. Using the Edit Migration Behavior option in Object Transporter, you can now select to merge the migrating security policies by default with corresponding policies on the target tenant, or you can select to override them. You can make selections for each policy in a package, or for the entire package. 
This enhancement: 
     • Enhances migration safety and confidence. 
    • Reduces the risk of accidental data loss or permission changes in production tenants. 
    • Increases flexibility to handle diverse migration scenarios. 
    • Preserves target tenant integrity by only adding permissions to policies when migrating. 
    • Achieves clearer, more predictable outcomes for security policy migrations. 
    • Streamlines decision making during migration. 
    • Addresses concerns about overwriting security configurations. 
    • Adopts a more agile approach to security policy management.
record.New Functionality:
We update these tasks to include the Edit Migration Behavior option when you migrate 1 or more modified security policies with Object Transporter: 
 Migrate With Object Transporter 
 Migrate Configuration Extract 
 Configuration Catalog 
 Object Transporter displays the option on the Pre-Migration Status page of Object Transporter when any of these packages contain modified domain or business process security policies: 
 A security configuration package. 
 A configuration extract. 
 A package from the configuration catalog. 
 By clicking Edit Migration Behavior, you can select 1 of these options from a table of modified security policies in your package: 
 Merge (Recommended): The default migration behavior. Merges all modified security policies in the package to the corresponding ones on the target tenant, resulting in added security groups and roles for the policy and no removals. 
 Override: Replaces the security polices on the target tenant with the corresponding ones on the source tenant. 
 Manual Selection: Enables you to individually select the modified security policies to merge or override. This option provides the greatest level of control over migration behavior. 
 If a package contains new or unchanged security policies, Object Transporter displays them in the Diff report. It doesn’t include them in the table of policies for the option.

record.What's New Item: Object Transporter Migration Workflow - Workday 2025 Release 1 - Object Transporter Migration Workflow
record.Feature Description:
We streamline the migration workflow of Object Transporter to enable you to better view and optionally exclude modified instances from migrating to your target tenant. The new layout provides you with an improved navigation experience on the instances present in your package in the Pre Migration Diff report. 
 You can now see top level instances and their dependencies organized by their implementation type and categorized on 3 new status tabs: Modified, New, and No Change. You can easily drill down to top-level instances to view dependencies. You can also open a dedicated window in the workflow to exclude modified instances from your migration. 
 
The new layout and navigation of workflow pages makes it easier for you to: 
 Navigate to increasing levels of detail and status for instances in scope for migration. 
 
 Quickly see which instances and dependencies will change on the target tenant as a result of the migration. 
 
 Identify instances with circular dependences. 
 
 Exclude modified instances or dependencies that you don't want to migrate. 
 
 Migrate large configuration packages or extracts without affecting performance.
record.New Functionality:
Workday updates the Migrate with Object Transporter task to improve the search and navigation of these workflow pages: 
 Pre-Migration Diff Report 
 Dependencies Diff 
 Attribute Diff 
 On the Pre-Migration Diff Report page, we now organize instances by implementation type and provide these tabs to categorize the status of each instance in a migration: 
     • All: Displays all instances in scope for a migration. 
    • Modified: Displays instances that differ from corresponding target tenant instances on Workday migrates unless you specifically exclude them. 
    • New: Displays instances that Workday adds to the target tenant. 
    • No Change: Displays instances that are already present on the target tenant and therefore aren't migrated. 
 We also add a new Managed Modified Instance page, available from the new Manage Modified Instances button on the Dependencies Diff page. Use this page to: 
     • Exclude modified instances from migration. 
    • View differences in attributes for modified instances. 
 Workday also introduces page loading to the workflow to help improve performance when you migrate large configuration packages or extracts.

application_adapter.missing_field_policy: Empty strings represent unavailable fields. Do not invent values or mislabel Feature Description as Business Benefits.

decision_policy.match: At least one catalog title directly represents the changed functional data/workflow; acceptable alternatives handle genuine actor/scope ambiguity.
decision_policy.no_matching_e2e: The documented feature is outside the explicit scope of the catalog titles. This means a catalog gap, not no testing needed or no business impact.
decision_policy.unable_to_identify: A plausible cross-process effect or partial title overlap exists, but missing tenant dependencies/script coverage prevents selecting a primary E2E.
decision_policy.single_best_selection: Select one exact full catalog name, never a comma-separated combination. Supporting tests are not interchangeable with accepted primary labels.
decision_policy.review_required: True is a conservative triage expectation for title-only catalog coverage. Report this separately; human review is not assumed completed.
decision_policy.confidence: No numerical gold confidence is invented. Compare decisions and accepted selections; evaluate calibration only after collecting outcomes from SME-adjudicated labels.

evaluation_protocol.input_isolation: Expose only each case.input and referenced e2e_catalog to the system under test. Never send expected, source_evidence, recommendations or grading text with the prompt.
evaluation_protocol.partitions: Use development cases for prompt iteration and test cases for final evaluation. Keep identical group_id values together across tasks and versions.
primary_metrics: Decision macro-F1 across the three mapping labels.
Accepted primary E2E exact-match accuracy on gold match cases.
End-to-end decision plus accepted-primary accuracy on mapping cases.
False positive match rate on no_matching_e2e and unable_to_identify cases, separately.
Catalog hallucination rate: selected non-null E2E not in catalog.
Source-quote validity and substantive evidence coverage.
QA semantic assertion accuracy and contradiction rate.
evaluation_protocol.retrieval_metric: Recall@k: on gold match cases, count success when at least one acceptable_e2e_names value is retrieved. Inspect misses before attributing downstream errors to the model.
evaluation_protocol.aggregation: Report mapping and QA scores separately, split by release, decision and functional area. Report both micro and macro scores because many notes are outside the catalog. Exclude out_of_year_control from 2025 headline scores.
hard_failures: A non-match decision with a non-null primary E2E.
Fabricated evidence presented as a source quote.
Substantive factual contradiction of the supplied note.
evaluation_protocol.matching_rule: For decision/e2e score, require gold decision and selected name in acceptable_e2e_names for match; otherwise require gold decision and null. No string similarity for catalog labels.

release_note.description:
With this release, Workday enables you to generate a list of eligible candidates for job requisitions. Selecting officials, such as recruiters and hiring managers, can now qualify, track, and hire the best eligible candidates by creating a certificate. 
Certificate of Eligibles enables hiring managers and recruiters to efficiently assess candidates who meet federal, state, or local government compliance. This feature can be used in tandem with Candidate Rating, Candidate Ranking, and Veteran's Preference which are all configurable.
release_note.changes:
New Domains 
 We deliver the following domains (secured to the Recruiting functional area): 
 Manage: Certificate of Eligibles 
 
 Audit: Certificate of Eligibles 
 
 New Security Segments 
 We add these 2 new security segments to the Workday delivered Job Application Security Segment to ensure hiring managers can only view and take action on applications from the candidate grid that have been part of issued certificates: 
 Active Certificate of Eligibles 
 
 All Certificate of Eligibles 
 
 New Business Processes and Tasks 
 Workday delivers the following business processes (secured to the Recruiting functional area): 
 Create Certificate of Eligibles, which enables selecting officials to determine criteria for a candidate to be placed on a certificate. 
 
 Return Certificate of Eligibles, which enables selecting officials to return the certificate. 
 
 You can use the new Create Certificate of Eligibles task to initiate an action on the Create Certificate of Eligibles business process and as a subprocess on the Return Certificate of Eligibles business process. The Return Certificate of Eligibles business process and the Return Certificate of Eligibles task (accessed from the certificate) allows you to request additional candidates. In addition, you can choose to save the task for later and revisit your candidate list by using the new Revise Certificate of Eligibles task (accessed from My Tasks or the Revise Certificate of Eligibles button on the Candidates tab). 
 Workday also delivers a new Audit Certificate of Eligibles task (secured to the Audit: Certificate of Eligibles domain) so that you can audit a returned or expired Certificate of Eligibles with the related actions menu from a Certificate of Eligibles instance.

 We deliver a new View Certificate of Eligibles report (secured to the Manage: Certificate of Eligibles domain) so that you can view a list of candidates by job requisition and profile. 
 Certificate of Eligibles Sequence Generator Function 
 We deliver a new certificate of eligibles sequence generator function on the Edit Tenant Setup – HCM task enabling you to set up a sequence generator for the ID Definition for Certificate of Eligibles report field.

 We add a new Certificate of Eligibles grid that you can customize and configure on the Maintain Candidate List Assignment task. 
 
 Web Services 
 We also update these new web services so that you can update the certificate of eligibles grid field:

release_note.title: Merging Security Policies
release_note.description:
Workday now enables you to migrate modified security policies with significantly improved safety and granular control. Using the Edit Migration Behavior option in Object Transporter, you can now select to merge the migrating security policies by default with corresponding policies on the target tenant, or you can select to override them. You can make selections for each policy in a package, or for the entire package. 
This enhancement: 
     • Enhances migration safety and confidence. 
    • Reduces the risk of accidental data loss or permission changes in production tenants. 
    • Increases flexibility to handle diverse migration scenarios. 
    • Preserves target tenant integrity by only adding permissions to policies when migrating. 
    • Achieves clearer, more predictable outcomes for security policy migrations. 
    • Streamlines decision making during migration. 
    • Addresses concerns about overwriting security configurations. 
    • Adopts a more agile approach to security policy management.
release_note.changes:
We update these tasks to include the Edit Migration Behavior option when you migrate 1 or more modified security policies with Object Transporter: 
 Migrate With Object Transporter 
 Migrate Configuration Extract 
 Configuration Catalog 
 Object Transporter displays the option on the Pre-Migration Status page of Object Transporter when any of these packages contain modified domain or business process security policies: 
 A security configuration package. 
 A configuration extract. 
 A package from the configuration catalog. 
 By clicking Edit Migration Behavior, you can select 1 of these options from a table of modified security policies in your package: 
 Merge (Recommended): The default migration behavior. Merges all modified security policies in the package to the corresponding ones on the target tenant, resulting in added security groups and roles for the policy and no removals. 
 Override: Replaces the security polices on the target tenant with the corresponding ones on the source tenant. 
 Manual Selection: Enables you to individually select the modified security policies to merge or override. This option provides the greatest level of control over migration behavior. 
 If a package contains new or unchanged security policies, Object Transporter displays them in the Diff report. It doesn’t include them in the table of policies for the option.

release_note.title: Object Transporter Migration Workflow
release_note.description:
We streamline the migration workflow of Object Transporter to enable you to better view and optionally exclude modified instances from migrating to your target tenant. The new layout provides you with an improved navigation experience on the instances present in your package in the Pre Migration Diff report. 
 You can now see top level instances and their dependencies organized by their implementation type and categorized on 3 new status tabs: Modified, New, and No Change. You can easily drill down to top-level instances to view dependencies. You can also open a dedicated window in the workflow to exclude modified instances from your migration. 
 
The new layout and navigation of workflow pages makes it easier for you to: 
 Navigate to increasing levels of detail and status for instances in scope for migration. 
 
 Quickly see which instances and dependencies will change on the target tenant as a result of the migration. 
 
 Identify instances with circular dependences. 
 
 Exclude modified instances or dependencies that you don't want to migrate. 
 
 Migrate large configuration packages or extracts without affecting performance.

 Dependencies Diff 
 Attribute Diff

     • All: Displays all instances in scope for a migration. 
    • Modified: Displays instances that differ from corresponding target tenant instances on Workday migrates unless you specifically exclude them. 
    • New: Displays instances that Workday adds to the target tenant.

 We also add a new Managed Modified Instance page, available from the new Manage Modified Instances button on the Dependencies Diff page. Use this page to:

 Workday also introduces page loading to the workflow to help improve performance when you migrate large configuration packages or extracts.
